Where this started

At 16, my 3D Design A Level project was Venice's MOSE storm barrier, which I redesigned as a movable barrier based on the Thames Barrier. What pulled me in was solving the problem across all its parts, at small scale.

Working through it showed me how much civil engineering can do, including protecting people in coastal zones. That's why I'm studying it, and why I'm taking Ocean Engineering as a minor. I later gave a Student Society talk on the problems MOSE faces.
